item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1

  • Automated Telegram Briefings: Scheduled daily portfolio performance reports delivered directly to your Telegram bot.
  • Dual Currency Support: View converted secondary currency equivalents (≈) alongside preferred currency in portfolio briefings.
  • Streamlined Profit Metrics: Clear separation between lifetime total profit, open unrealized returns (with %), and realized gains.
  • Japanese Mutual Funds: Accurate fund naming and latest NAV change tracking for 投資信託 assets.
  • Portfolio Weight Sorting: Automatic sorting by portfolio weight descending across asset summaries.
